name: Alter Breath Weapon (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Breath weapon

Benefit(s): When you take this feat select one of the following energy descriptors: acid, cold, electricity, fire.

Three times per day as a free action you may alter the damage your breath weapon deals to this energy type.
